vesselOwner.features: Length 129 feet 6 inches, beam 28 feet 6 inches, draft 12 feet 6 inches. Launched in 1904. The visible red hull, white deckhouses and yellow masts depict the restored fleet vessel.

survey.features: Original government hull profile and lines archived on sheets 1 and 4, with the modern hull and mast detail documented in the survey photo series.

berth.features: Historic Ships Wharf is the permanent museum berth in Lake Union Park.

water.features: USGS documents typical regulated NAVD88 gage range of 5.1 to 5.7 m, with occasional observed levels outside that range.
